tips.age: Age-related risk can't be changed, but regular screening becomes more important over time.
tips.bmi: Gradual, sustainable weight management can meaningfully lower this risk factor.
tips.systolic_bp: Reducing sodium intake and staying active can help lower blood pressure over time.
tips.glucose: Reducing refined carbohydrates and regular exercise both help regulate blood glucose.
tips.cholesterol: A diet lower in saturated fat and higher in fiber can help improve cholesterol levels.
tips.smoker: Quitting smoking is one of the highest-impact changes for both of these risk categories.
tips.family_history: Family history can't be changed, but it's a good reason to screen earlier and more often.
tips.activity_level: Increasing regular physical activity meaningfully lowers both risk categories.
